data.title: International Hantavirus Conference
data.lede: On-site registration and Opening Event on November 1. ICH2026 runs November 2-4, followed by the Andes Virus Workshop on November 5.

data.heading: Register at Hotel Bellavista before the Opening Event.
data.body_html:
On-site registration: 15:00–18:00 at Hotel Bellavista.

The Opening Event starts at 19:00. Please complete on-site registration beforehand to receive your beverage vouchers.

articles.heading: Registration and Opening Event
articles.body_html:
15:00–18:00: On-site registration at Hotel Bellavista.

19:00: Opening Event. Prior registration is essential to obtain your beverage vouchers.

articles.heading: Scientific meeting and optional excursion
articles.body_html:
Approximately 08:30–13:00: Scientific meeting.

Free afternoon for an optional excursion to Petrohué Falls. Separate registration and payment are required on site.

articles.heading: Final conference day and Gala Dinner
articles.body_html:
Approximately 08:30–18:30: Scientific meeting.

19:30: Gala Dinner. End of the ICH2026 meeting.

articles.heading: Andes Virus Workshop
articles.body_html:
Approximately 08:30–17:00: Andes Virus Workshop.

The detailed programme will be published soon. Scientific session times are approximate.

data.heading: Information for speakers and poster presenters.
data.body_html:
Oral talks

12 minutes for the presentation, followed by 3 minutes for questions.

Lightning talks

6 minutes for the presentation, followed by 2 minutes for questions.

Posters

88 cm wide × 120 cm high (approximately 34.6 × 47.2 inches). Portrait orientation.
